about.title: From backend to AI agents
about.p1: I'm a backend engineer now focused on AI-driven automation. I currently build agentic workflows and automation pipelines in Python and NestJS. My background is in the Java/Spring ecosystem, which shaped how I think about clean architecture and maintainable systems.
about.p2: I'm a Systems Analyst, currently in my 4th year of engineering and on track to also earn degrees in Artificial Intelligence and Systems Engineering at Universidad Tecnológica Nacional (UTN-FRC). That gave me a solid foundation in software architecture, databases, and development best practices, which I apply to every project, prioritizing clean code and well-structured solutions.
about.p3: Day to day I design APIs and backend services, and I build agents that use real tools: MCP servers, search over internal data and flows with human approval. I care that what I build can be measured and maintained, so I reach for tests, evals and structured outputs before a demo that only works once.
